name: The Ties That Bind

angles.text: As a druid, you know the Cenarion Circle holds balance and kinship sacred. Haalien’s betrayal and the bloodshed among fellow druids are grave offenses against the order.

faq.answer: Elegael Thornpaw is a druid stationed in Shadowgale Forest. As cultists attack, she directs you to hunt down Commander Haalien after discovering his part in the bloodshed.
faq.q: Who offers the quest The Ties That Bind?

faq.answer: Commander Haalien was a druid of the Cenarion Circle who vanished months before the cultist attacks. He willingly joined the hostile cultists and rose to command their forces against his kin.

Haalien left his druidic circle to command cultists who slaughtered innocents and spilled the blood of his brethren. Elegael orders his execution because of his crimes and the danger he poses to the forest.
faq.q: Why does Elegael want Commander Haalien dead?

aliases: how do elegael and haalien know each other
faq.answer: Commander Haalien is Elegael Thornpaw’s cousin. Enraged by his crimes, she admits that killing her own kin would have been a bitter burden, so she asks you to help.
faq.q: What is the connection between Elegael Thornpaw and Haalien?

faq.answer: Even the local druids do not know exactly why the cultists came to Shadowgale Forest. Former circle members like Haalien lead them, directing violence and bloodshed against the forest’s defenders.
faq.q: Why are cultists present in the Shadowgale Forest?

aliases: where does ties that bind happen
faq.answer: The events unfold in Shadowgale Forest, where Elegael Thornpaw investigates the cultist attack and confronts her cousin’s betrayal.
faq.q: Where does this quest take place?

sections.body: Druids face a vicious cultist attack in Shadowgale Forest. Elegael Thornpaw finds Haalien’s scent over the slaughter. Haalien was a druid of the circle who vanished months ago, but he did not perish in the wilds. He joined the invading cultists and now commands their violent campaign against his former kin.
sections.title: Betrayal in the Forest

sections.body: Haalien betrayed more than his vows to the Cenarion Circle. When Elegael sees the fallen commander’s severed head, she reveals that Haalien was her cousin. Fury at his atrocities could not ease the burden of striking down her own kin, so she could not bear it alone. His death ends the life of a renegade whose malice cost numerous innocent lives.
sections.title: Blood and Kinship

summary: Elegael Thornpaw faces a traitor among Shadowgale Forest’s druids. Haalien vanished months ago, then joined the attacking cultists and rose to command them. Now Elegael orders his execution.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Ties That Bind
